description: Start a new session of a coding tool or shell in Agent Guild. Ask the person first. It opens on every screen connected to Agent Guild.

account.description: The account id to run under. Defaults to "default".

cwd.description: The folder to start in. Defaults to the home folder.

name.description: A name for the session's card.

resume.description: The id of one of the tool's own earlier sessions to resume.

tool.description: The tool: "claude", "codex", "antigravity", "grok", "docker" or "shell", or a provider id from guild_status.

name: start_session
title: Start a session
